name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.177
notes: v177 simplifies Log Activity by removing Google Maps route fields and reorganizing the activity workflow into Activity, Before Activity BP, Activity Details, Start Activity, and After Activity.
label: LogActivitySimplification
summary: Simplifies Log Activity and removes Google Maps-dependent navigation and route-statistics entry.
whatsNew: Log Activity now flows top-to-bottom: Activity, Before Activity BP, Activity Details, Start Activity, After Activity.
Google Maps, route destination, distance, speed, elevation, and route-summary entry were removed from Log Activity.
Before-activity BP status and fresh BP entry now stay together in the same section.
After-activity entry is limited to automatic duration, optional fluid, snack/meal, symptoms, notes, and Save.
fixes: Reduced Log Activity scrolling and removed fields with unclear long-term health-response value.
Removed Google Maps-specific saved-field handling from the Log Activity workflow.
testing: Verified JavaScript syntax with node --check all.js.
